patch_checks.mclk_source: Diablo.sv assigns HDMI_MCLK directly from clk_audio; sys_top instantiates sole pll_audio output as clk_audio; generated PLL output is 24.576000 MHz, 50% duty.
patch_checks.mclk_sdc: HDMI_MCLK_FWD is guarded to one source pin, one source clock and one output port, divide_by 1, without -invert.
patch_checks.wildcard_exception_audit: No broad wildcard appears in the C25 false-path targets; the PLL hierarchy wildcard is collection-count guarded to one source.
patch_checks.rtl_alias_basis: Diablo.sv assigns SD_SCK, SD_MOSI and SD_CS to Z; sys_top maps the permitted SDIO/SD_SPI_CS aliases accordingly.

validator_finding.detail: internal_timing_unchanged compares only baseline/after setup and hold summaries. The pass predicate never compares recovery, removal or minimum-pulse values and never requires any slack to be positive. report_fpga_timing.tcl calls report_timing without -hold, -recovery, -removal or a pulse-specific report, so timing_corners_unchanged is setup-only. The current full Diablo.sta.rpt baseline and trial reports independently show all five positive worst-case values above, but the validator can report pass if those values regress in a future trial.

disposable_trial_audit.basis: run_dir is a fresh ROOT/.work/c25/runs/<timestamp-uuid> created with exist_ok=False; snapshot is copied into fitted-trial; Quartus subprocesses run with cwd=run_dir or cwd=trial; project output_directory is relative output_files; no rmtree/remove operation exists. The only unlink removes the temporary immutable-receipt link source.

review_commands: bounded source/RTL inspection of Diablo.sdc, validate_c25_sdc.py, Diablo.sv, sys/sys_top.v, sys/pll_audio/pll_audio_0002.v
receipt/report hash recomputation and exact before/after scope parsing
